propositions: Enable verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close in rebar.toml while library defaults remain false, allowing legacy unpinned attestations to pass both gates without backfill.
End-to-end lifecycle tests must prove material pin invalidation propagates only after narrow actual changes, and unchanged successful re-review produces no further downstream propagation.

Public lifecycle surfaces must demonstrate enable/disable/re-enable cycles, depends_on and blocks normalization to canonical prerequisites, execution-time self-edit invalidation, in_progress-to-open reset, code-only drift at close, deleted/archived pinned target handling, and audited force-close behavior.

Stale material-pin drift and missing or phase-incompatible close-plan review must deterministically reject operations with specific exit codes, preserve status unchanged, and include exact remediation tokens visible to users.
